_doc: IC v3 = v2 (CI+VRP gate) + DISABLE adjustments. May 6 2026. Trade-level analysis of v2 holdout revealed the adjustment logic is the strategy's biggest loss-maker: 27 of 29 mid-trade adjustments lost money on holdout, total -₹5,719. EXIT economics alone (no adjusts) had PF 1.066 / 62%% WR. Disabling adjustments is THEORY-GROUNDED (May 1 trade audit found adjusts fire 1-2 min after entry, bias to CE side, lock losses on positions that recover) and SURE-SHOT (multiple independent evidence streams converge). adjustment_threshold_pct=9999 effectively disables the adjustment trigger. All other params identical to v2.
